panel.introduction: Daphnis travels inside the Keeler Gap in Saturn’s A ring. This tiny moon raises waves along the gap’s edges, while Cassini’s close views reveal ridges and a coating of fine material.

controls.label: Monochrome
controls.description: Cassini clear-filter observations with fine detail from a green-filter image, projected onto the released PDS shape using its measured camera geometry. Bounded illumination correction and exposure matching reduce photographed lighting. Gray grid marks unavailable samples; cast-shadow terrain is not reconstructed.

controls.label: Elevation
controls.description: Radial height above a 3.8 km reference sphere from the Cassini shape model. Includes the moon’s broad irregular shape; it is not local height above a geoid. Fixed relief lighting reveals model slopes. Small craters are not reliably resolved.
